scope: Bounded worldwide catalogue expansion. Indigenous stories and Nations remain distinct; this is not complete worldwide or US Nation coverage.
editorial_choices: Official source descriptions were read before short original summaries were written.
Full films, shorts, trailers, excerpts, recorded programs and source-only entries are labeled separately.
A stable regional mix opens the collection without personalized ranking, popularity scores or inferred locations.
Source-only and contextual holds are not counted as configured players. Language replacements count once per work.
Recorded interviews and audio-led programs are labeled; original production dates remain unknown where only upload dates are known.
review_limits: No complete-film, caption-accuracy or worldwide current playback certification.
Provider metadata and offered-source checks establish configured viewing candidates; availability can vary by region, account and time.
No community endorsement, person-check receipt, new recognition status or legal/scientific ruling inferred from a film.
No media rehosting, source imagery generation or sacred designs.
publication_state: Independently reviewed release candidate. Source and local validation receipts are recorded in publication_review.json; PR merge and live deployment verification are separate gates.
